evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the per-run directory at line 612 and returns without fsyncing the record base. A later durable_write inside the run directory makes the receipt and that directory durable, but it does not persist the base directory's entry for the new run directory. A crash/power loss can therefore lose the run directory and its recovery state after admission. Add a directory fsync of base after mkdir, and of base's parent when base was newly created, before returning/claiming admission. This is a routine durability fix, not a new requirement needing owner judgment.
